Job description  Realizar os atendimentos técnicos compreendendo o diagnóstico, reparo troca de peças e conservação dos produtos operados pela empresa em sua área de atuação, utilizando os conhecimentos, sistemas e ferramentas disponibilizados pela organização, com vistas ao pronto reestabelecimento do serviço e o atingimento do nível de serviço requerido.  Main responsibilities   Tático-Operacional: efetuar os atendimentos designados pelos sistemas de gestão de tickets e pela equipe de retaguarda, utilizando os conhecimentos e ferramentas disponibilizadas pela empresa, de modo a restabelecer o serviço na primeira visita, evitando as reincidências em prol da qualidade e do atingimento dos níveis de serviço acordados.  Diagnóstico Técnico e troca de peças: determinar as causas dos defeitos valendo-se do conhecimento técnico e das ferramentas disponibilizadas pela empresa, efetuar a troca das peças necessárias ao reestabelecimento do serviço visando o pronto atendimento às necessidades do cliente.  Ativação: atuar no processo de ativação de novos serviços inspecionando a qualidade das instalações, efetuando a habilitação dos equipamentos, testando e tomando ações para garantir o bom funcionamento do produto, da infraestrutura e demais dispositivos que compõem o ponto.  Manutenção: uma vez ativado o serviço, atuar na manutenção, conservação e reparo dos equipamentos que o compõem e da infraestrutura associada, através de diagnostico, retirada de defeitos, reposição de insumos e troca de consumíveis. Realizar os testes que assegurem o correto funcionamento dos elementos em manutenção. Reparo/troca dos componentes intra e extra cofre que apresentarem defeito do equipamento, identificado através de conhecimento técnico.  Vistoria,Conservação e Limpeza: vistoriar e manter limpos e bem conservados os equipamentos e demais dispositivos que compõem o ponto. Sinalizar as necessidades de pintura, troca de elementos, sinalização e demais componentes cuja manutenção não possa ser feita diretamente.  Instalação e Testes de Dispositivos de Segurança: realizar testes periódicos e de funcionamento dos dispositivos de segurança que compõem o produto. Quando necessário, efetuar a instalação de novos dispositivos de segurança conforme determinações específicas da área competente.  Manipulação de Consumíveis e componentes: sempre que necessário, solicitar consumíveis e componentes ao estoque, zelar pela sua embalagem e integridade, efetuar as trocas necessárias, restituir os componentes danificados ao estoque, garantir o correto registro das condições de recebimento e devolução dos mesmos  Registro de Atividade: realizar os registros de entrada e saída bem como de suas atividades ao longo da jornada de trabalho.  Aprimoramento: contribuir com sugestões e ideias para o aperfeiçoamento dos processos e equipamentos que compõem o leque de serviços oferecidos pela empresa, bem como indicar possíveis oportunidades de negócios na sua área de atuação.  Zelo pelo patrimônio: zelar pelos bens da empresa colocados à sua disposição, garantindo a conservação e manutenção adequada dos mesmos. Sinalizar às áreas responsáveis qualquer eventualidade que implique na perda ou dano destes bens. Acompanhar a realização de serviços de terceiros zelando pelo patrimônio e garantindo a efetividade e adequação da atividade.  Treinamento e Reuniões: participar dos treinamentos e atividades de capacitação disponibilizadas pela empresa. Participar das reuniões de equipe.  Capacitação: Acompanhar e desenvolver novos colaboradores, transmitindo os conhecimentos adquiridos, bem como as normas e práticas exigidas pela empresa, com vistas a capacitar os novos funcionários ao pleno desenvolvimento de sua função.    Requirements and skills   Escolaridade: Técnico Completo em elétrica, eletrônica, mecatrônica, mecânica, informática ou afins.  Conhecimentos: Conhecimentos de microinformática (hardware e software).  Imprescindível saber dirigir e ter CNH B válida.  Disponibilidade para trabalhar finais de semanas e feriados.     #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: [Job-30877] Content Operations Analyst Senior
description:
Confira a oportunidade para [Job-30877] Content Operations Analyst Senior em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.  With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.  We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.  Role Overview  The Senior Content Analyst will build and manage CI&T’s North American content operations ecosystem. This hands‑on role oversees CMS governance, content repositories, metadata and taxonomy, SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), content lifecycle management, and AI‑enabled workflows. The goal is to make content searchable, reusable, discoverable, and optimized for both search engines and AI‑powered platforms.  Key Responsibilities  Content Operations and CMS   Build and maintain centralized content and proof‑point repositories.  Establish metadata, taxonomy, tagging, naming, and version‑control standards.  Manage content organization, localization, refresh, archiving, and retirement.  Coordinate website publishing and ensure content meets brand, accessibility, metadata, and quality standards.  Improve CMS workflows and resolve publishing or governance issues across teams.    SEO and GEO   Lead North America SEO and GEO governance.  Apply on‑page SEO, structured content, internal linking, metadata, and keyword best practices.  Support structured data, schemas, topic clusters, FAQs, and entity‑based content.  Conduct keyword, competitor, search‑intent, and content‑gap research.  Monitor discoverability and recommend content improvements.    AI‑Enabled Content Operations   Design, test, and maintain AI‑assisted and agentic content workflows.  Use AI for research, drafting, editing, optimization, repurposing, tagging, summarization, and quality assurance.  Build reusable prompts, workflow templates, and human‑review processes.  Evaluate AI‑generated content for accuracy, quality, originality, brand alignment, and source use.  Establish AI governance, safeguards, and documentation.  Track improvements in content quality, speed, reuse, and efficiency.    Performance and Optimization   Measure content performance, freshness, reuse, search visibility, and repository effectiveness.  Identify content to update, consolidate, repurpose, or retire.  Develop reports and dashboards for content operations, SEO/GEO, and AI adoption.  Track metrics such as time to publish, content reuse, search success, AI‑assisted production, and cycle‑time reduction.    Required Qualifications   High‑level English proficiency and the ability to communicate clearly with North American and global teams.  4–6 years of experience in content operations, digital marketing, SEO, content management, marketing operations, or a related field.  Experience in B2B, technology, consulting, professional services, or enterprise marketing.  Hands‑on experience with CMS platforms, SEO, content repositories, metadata, taxonomy, and lifecycle management.  Working knowledge of GEO, AI search visibility, structured content, and emerging discovery practices.  Practical experience using generative AI and building multi‑step workflows, automations, agents, or prompt‑based systems.  Strong understanding of content governance, quality assurance, version control, and human review of AI‑generated content.  Strong organizational, documentation, communication, and process‑development skills.  Ability to work independently across teams, regions, and time zones. Practical experience with agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or custom agent orchestration).  Proficiency in Python for scripting and AI service integration.  Hands-on experience with AWS and/or GCP cloud platforms for deploying and managing application workloads.  Strong understanding of REST API design and service-to-service integration patterns.  Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work across the full stack, from UI to database, without silos. Experience with vector databases and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures as a consumer of these services.  Knowledge of containerization (Docker/Kubernetes). Background in enterprise application modernization projects that incorporate agentic AI capabilities.     #J-18808-Ljbffr

The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services.Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The team focuses on proactive hunting for and mitigating potential security threats on Nubank to protect our customers' financial assets and data. For that, we perform many tasks such as embedding and developing security controls on the applications, supporting all engineers during the software development lifecycle.Our AppSec team is at the forefront of enabling secure innovation at Nubank. We believe security should be an enabler, not a blocker, and we build scalable solutions to help developers ship secure code without friction. From designing AI-powered threat modeling tools to automating security in CI/CD, our work impacts every Nubanker engineer. About the role As a Security Engineer in our Application Security (AppSec) team, you will be part of the group responsible for enabling secure software development practices across Nubank’s entire engineering organization. We support teams working with a diverse technology stack – including Clojure, Python, Go for backend and Kotlin, Swift, Dart for mobile – by embedding security into their SDLC. This role is ideal for someone with a strong foundation in application security concepts, who enjoys working closely with engineering teams to drive security best practices, and who has a keen interest in emerging areas such as AI security and threat modeling. Your mission will include helping design and deploy security tools in our CI/CD pipelines (SAST, DAST, SCA), performing threat modeling for new projects, supporting security reviews, and contributing to the automation of AppSec processes, including those involving new AI technologies like Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers and agents. You'll be responsible for Embed security practices into the SDLC across backend, mobile, and web applications. Deploy and maintain security tools (SAST, DAST, SCA, MAST) in CI/CD pipelines.  Perform threat modeling and security reviews for new and existing projects.  Develop scripts and tools (Python, Go, Bash) to automate security checks and processes.  Collaborate with engineering teams to explain and remediate vulnerabilities.  Support AI-related security initiatives, ensuring safe adoption of ML/AI features in products.  Contribute to the evolution of internal security guidelines and baselines.  Participate in cross-functional discussions to align security requirements with business goals.   We are looking for a person who has Must-have Solid understanding of application security concepts and secure software development practices.  Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and implementing security tools (e.g., SAST, DAST, SCA).  Knowledge of scripting/programming with commonly used languages like Python, Go, bash, etc for automation and tooling.  Familiarity with container security tools (e.g., Trivy, Aqua).  Experience working with modern software architectures: Web, Mobile, APIs, and MCPs.  Strong communication and collaboration skills to work with multi-disciplinary teams.   Nice to Have Previous experience conducting security assessments in distributed systems environments.  Experience with tools like Semgrep, Fortify, Checkmarx, Veracode.  Experience with pipeline tools like Github Actions, Gitlab Workflow, others.  Experience with AI security concepts and emerging AI/ML security risks.  Familiarity with threat modeling methodologies (e.g., STRIDE, PASTA, OWASP Threat Dragon).  Knowledge of regulatory and compliance requirements relevant to financial services. Buscamos alguém que se identifique com nossos valores, com forte engajamento ético e profissional , conciliando seu crescimento pessoal com nossa missão de promover a saúde, e a preservação da vida e do meio ambiente, atuando em projetos que impactam diretamente na sociedade, na qualidade de vida e na construção de um paradigma de progresso e crescimento econômico sustentáveis. Fazer parte deste projeto te inspira? Então inscreva-se em nosso processo seletivo!  Responsabilidades e atribuições   Realizar todas as determinações analíticas e registros de acordo com os requisitos da ISO 17025;  Operar equipamentos de alta complexidade como: GCMSMS e LCMSMS;  Preparo e padronização de soluções, diluições e extração das amostras;  Prestar suporte no controle periódico da calibração dos equipamentos, controlar e inspecionar os registros, as condições ambientais e equipamentos utilizados nos ensaios;  Identificar a necessidade de revisões de procedimentos e planilhas de cálculos e outros documentos da área;  Propor melhorias e otimizações nos métodos existentes;    Requisitos e qualificações   Técnico completo ou Graduação em Química, Alimentos, Farmácia, ou áreas correlatas;  Conhecimento em analises físico químicas nas técnicas de espectrometria de massas com vivência em determinação de contaminantes orgânicos em diferentes tipos de amostras, conhecimento em agroquímicos, método QuEChERS e extração de amostras será um diferencial;  Experiência na operação de equipamentos de alta complexidade e na validação de métodos analíticos (Protocolos MAPA, DOC CGCRE-0008 e ANVISA - RDC 166);  Conhecimento em BPL e ISO 17025;  Experiência na função;  Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente em Campinas- SP, de Segunda a Sexta das 07:30 às 17:30    Benefícios   Vale alimentação/refeição flexível;  Vale Transporte;  Gympass;  Convênio médico e odontológico coparticipativo;  Desconto Farmácia;  Seguro de Vida sem custo ao colaborador;  Programa de Vacinação;  Parceria SESC e SENAC;  Programa de segurança alimentar e nutricional;  Remuneração compatível ao mercado;  Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo;  Oportunidade de trabalhar em uma empresa sólida, com possibilidade de aprendizado, desenvolvimento de carreira e crescimento profissional. Role Overview The Senior Content Analyst will build and manage CI&T’s North American content operations ecosystem. This hands‑on role oversees CMS governance, content repositories, metadata and taxonomy, SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), content lifecycle management, and AI-enabled workflows. The goal is to make content searchable, reusable, discoverable, and optimized for both search engines and AI-powered platforms. Key Responsibilities Content Operations and CMS Build and maintain centralized content and proof‑point repositories. Establish metadata, taxonomy, tagging, naming, and version‑control standards. Manage content organization, localization, refresh, archiving, and retirement. Coordinate website publishing and ensure content meets brand, accessibility, metadata, and quality standards. Improve CMS workflows and resolve publishing or governance issues across teams.  SEO and GEO Lead North America SEO and GEO governance. Apply on‑page SEO, structured content, internal linking, metadata, and keyword best practices. Support structured data, schemas, topic clusters, FAQs, and entity‑based content. Conduct keyword, competitor, search‑intent, and content-gap research. Monitor discoverability and recommend content improvements.  AI-Enabled Content Operations Design, test, and maintain AI‑assisted and agentic content workflows. Use AI for research, drafting, editing, optimization, repurposing, tagging, summarization, and quality assurance. Build reusable prompts, workflow templates, and human‑review processes. Evaluate AI‑generated content for accuracy, quality, originality, brand alignment, and source use. Establish AI governance, safeguards, and documentation. Track improvements in content quality, speed, reuse, and efficiency.  Performance and Optimization Measure content performance, freshness, reuse, search visibility, and repository effectiveness. Identify content to update, consolidate, repurpose, or retire. Develop reports and dashboards for content operations, SEO/GEO, and AI adoption. Track metrics such as time to publish, content reuse, search success, AI‑assisted production, and cycle‑time reduction.  Required Qualifications High‑level English proficiency and the ability to communicate clearly with North American and global teams. 4–6 years of experience in content operations, digital marketing, SEO, content management, marketing operations, or a related field. Experience in B2B, technology, consulting, professional services, or enterprise marketing. Hands‑on experience with CMS platforms, SEO, content repositories, metadata, taxonomy, and lifecycle management. Working knowledge of GEO, AI search visibility, structured content, and emerging discovery practices. Practical experience using generative AI and building multi‑step workflows, automations, agents, or prompt‑based systems. Strong understanding of content governance, quality assurance, version control, and human review of AI‑generated content. Strong organizational, documentation, communication, and process‑development skills. Ability to work independently across teams, regions, and time zones. title: Sr Supply Chain Analyst
description:

About us We are a Team of passionate individuals, developing ground-breaking biological technologies designed to sustainably, and safely control pests that transmit disease, destroy crops and harm livestock. We do this work to improve lives and livelihoods around the world in the face of the growing threats that pests pose to human health and the global food supply. Whilst what we do relates to developing pest control technologies, Flyttr is about people and is in service to people. We are strongly committed to a set of values, principles, and behaviours, and foster a culture of trust, respect, creativity, and accountability. Click here to learn more, and here to read our CEO’s blog about trust and our culture. Purpose of the Job Flyttr is seeking a highly motivated and dedicated Supply Chain Analyst to join our team. In this role, you will support the planning, coordination, and optimization of supply chain operations, helping ensure the efficient flow of materials, inventory, and products while contributing to operational excellence and continuous improvement. The right person to join our Supply Chain team will share with us the passion for delivering our mission, the willingness to serve, the endless curiosity about our activities, and the creativity to always pursue the better solution. We are looking for a proactive, analytical, and collaborative professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and is committed to driving results through teamwork and innovation. Key Responsibilities Monitor and coordinate the end-to-end flow of materials, products, and information across the supply chain, from procurement through customer delivery. Develop and execute production planning activities based on installed capacity, sales demand, inventory levels, and business priorities. Plan, monitor, and control inventory levels for raw materials, components, supplies, and finished goods, ensuring product availability while minimizing excess inventory and obsolescence. Monitor purchase orders, follow up with suppliers, and coordinate material deliveries to ensure deadlines and agreed service levels are achieved. Analyse demand trends and support the forecasting process to improve supply planning and inventory decisions. Coordinate order fulfilment activities, managing invoicing while monitoring finished goods availability and shipping scheduling to ensure alignment with sales plan. Coordinate domestic and international transportation, shipments, and logistics providers, when applicable. Identify cost reduction opportunities, improve productivity, and support continuous improvement initiatives across supply chain processes. Support the S&OP process by consolidating demand, production, procurement, and logistics information for cross-functional planning. Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor performance and support decision-making. Assist in ERP master data maintenance related to suppliers, materials, inventory, and planning parameters. Collaborate closely with Sales, Procurement, Production, Finance and Logistics teams to ensure effective execution of supply chain activities. Operate in compliance with the company’s Integrated Management System, ensuring adherence to Quality, Environmental, Health & Safety standards, legal requirements, risk mitigation, sustainability, and continuous improvement  Skills, Experience, and Education Requirements Bachelor’s degree in production engineering, Business Administration, Logistics, or related fields. 5-8 years of progressive experience in Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics, Inventory Management, Operations Planning, or related areas. Solid experience in end-to-end Supply Chain processes, with strong hands-on experience in planning and operational execution. Experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, TOTVS, or similar, including practical knowledge of planning parameters, master data, purchasing, inventory, and production processes. Experience with inventory management and replenishment processes. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to analyse complex information, identify root causes, and translate insights into practical actions. Understanding of S&OP and cross-functional planning processes. Proficiency in Power BI or similar BI tools, including the ability to develop, maintain, and interpret dashboards and performance indicators. Advanced Microsoft Excel. Knowledge of Lean, Kaizen, or continuous improvement methodologies. Advanced English, with the ability to communicate effectively in professional and cross-functional environments.  Behavioural Requirements Commitment to and passion for the Flyttr mission. Demonstrated commitment to focusing on organizational needs and setting high standards to ensure quality is maintained. Positive, co-operative, and professional always. Excellent organizational and planning abilities. Attention to detail. Effective communication and interpersonal skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Service and team oriented. Flexible and accommodating in the face of changing requirements. Strong ownership and accountability.  Operate in compliance with the company’s Integrated Management System, ensuring adherence to Quality, Environmental, Health & Safety standards, legal requirements, risk mitigation, sustainability, and continuous improvement. Flyttr is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, or any other status protected by Brazilian law.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

Job description  Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com11salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico,110leitosde internação,14leitosdeUTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h.Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.  Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.  Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.  A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia.Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.  Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.  #vemserveracruz #vemparahospitalcare #vemserhospitalcare #vemproveracruz #jeitodeserveracruz  Main responsibilities   Interpretar projetos e definir materiais e métodos para execução dos serviços.  Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em sistemas elétricos, hidráulicos, gases medicinais, equipamentos, motores, bombas, geradores, redes e sistemas de controle.  Executar instalações, reparos, testes e medições em redes elétricas, hidráulicas, dados, telefonia, TV, aterramento e SPDA.
